'''GitDealFlow''' is a [[software as a service]] platform that derives [[venture capital]] [[deal flow]] signals from public [[GitHub]] activity.<ref>{{TODO: Tier-1 launch coverage citation}}</ref> The service combines an open-source [[Model Context Protocol]] (MCP) server with a paid web dashboard for tracking developer-engagement metrics on early-stage software projects.<ref>{{TODO: Tier-1 product description citation}}</ref>

The service is targeted at "developer-investors" — software engineers who allocate personal capital to early-stage [[startup company|startups]] — and is operated under the pseudonym "The Data Nerd."<ref>{{TODO: Tier-1 founder/positioning citation}}</ref>

== History ==
GitDealFlow launched on 17 April 2026.<ref>{{TODO: launch citation}}</ref> The free MCP server was published to the [[npm (software)|npm registry]] under the package name {{mono|@gitdealflow/mcp-signal}} and to the Vercel MCP marketplace.<ref>{{TODO: registry citation}}</ref> A paid dashboard tier offering sector-level signal aggregation, [[watchlist]] tracking, and email alerts followed shortly after launch.<ref>{{TODO: Tier-1 source}}</ref>

The methodology underlying the service was published as a working paper on the [[Social Science Research Network]] (SSRN) in 2026.<ref name="ssrn">{{cite web |url=https://ssrn.com/abstract=6606558 |title=A Longitudinal Panel of GitHub Engineering Velocity for Venture-Backed Startups: Dataset and Early Observations |author=The Data Nerd |website=SSRN |date=2026 |access-date={{TODO}} }}</ref>

== Methodology ==
GitDealFlow aggregates public [[GitHub]] event streams — including [[Star (GitHub)|stars]], [[Fork (software development)|forks]], contributor velocity, dependent-package adoption, and release cadence — and applies a scoring model to identify repositories whose growth patterns historically precede [[Series A]]–stage venture financing.<ref name="ssrn"/>

The dataset draws exclusively on public GitHub event streams; no private or proprietary data sources are used.<ref name="ssrn"/>

== Products ==
GitDealFlow is offered as a two-tier service:
* '''MCP server''' (free): An open implementation of the [[Model Context Protocol]] distributed via [[npm (software)|npm]], providing six tools for querying signal metadata.<ref>{{TODO: independent registry / coverage citation}}</ref>
* '''Dashboard''' (paid): A web dashboard at signals.gitdealflow.com offering sector signals, watchlist tracking, and email alerts.<ref>{{TODO: Tier-1 product coverage}}</ref>
